newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Weather-More rains predicted over Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Weather-More rains predicted over Sri Lanka.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department forecast more rains over most of Sri Lanka in the next 24 hours.
It said skies over the southern half of the island will remain partly cloudy with scattered showers or thundershowers in the Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces.
Isloated showers are also likely in the Central, Northwestern and Southern provinces, while Uva, Northcentral and Eastern provinces will experience showers on Monday afternnon and evening.
